reviews.title: No longer shows an accurate schedule, which is the whole point
reviews.text: Sometimes when I need to check my schedule, I will see other people’s shifts displayed as if they are my own. Refreshing works sometimes, closing and opening works sometimes. reviews.title: Dark mode uhh..
reviews.text:
I was looking forward to dark mode. How do you add dark mode but ruin the readability at the same time? I find it drastically harder to read. With the calendar day and date being so compact together then it only has a separated line between the date & your schedule. I wish the blue line that split your schedule & the day was able to customize the colors. Actually just to be able to customize it would be amazing. I would find colors that stand out more be easier for your eyes to catch. I also wish there were more ways to view your schedule as well. The compact barely has a change besides making it harder to read by squeezing all the words tightly together lol but the normal mode makes it gigantic.. It’s either large or small. No middle ground that makes it comfortable to read or use.

Tldr: Simply put, it feels like my eyes are working harder with this update.

reviews.title: The new update sucks
reviews.text: Ive been using hotschedules for years and ive loved it up until now. I absolutely hate the new update, I think it’s so ugly and it lacks the beautiful visual clarity that was there before. Previously, I could read my entire schedule with the quickest glance thanks to the clear declined shift layout, the black boxes highlighting specifically which shifts were mine, and the compact layout that allowed me to see the entire week and then some. Now these ugly schedule status boxes take up half the screen for no reason and I can’t even view one entire week on the first screen. I despise it so much it feels so cluttered and lacks all aesthetics now.

reviews.title: Such a scam...
reviews.text: Can't believe this app costs money when it has less features than the desktop version. When searching on the messages tab it limits you to a shortened time frame so any old messages you are searching for you cannot see them. Also if you want to look at the full weekly schedules of all employees like you do on desktop, that is simply not possible. Also when trying to message employees you have to SCROLL through all the listed names instead of just typing and auto suggesting. Absolute money grab of an app with less features than desktop version. Can't wait for more business to switch from HotSchedules and stop using this god awful dinosaur age system.

reviews.title: Complaint
reviews.text: It’s an ok app. Looking at whose scheduled is a joke tho. The AM and PM buttons need to go. Just have the dates and when you click it, the entire day pops up. Some AM shifts pop up in the PM it’s not accurate. And also when you submit availability there’s GOTTA be some simpler way. Yall really just said “let’s make this as inconvenient as possible” please give receipts on availability requests too. My boss accused me of not submitting availability so I went to screenshot it but there was no date or time on when I submitted it. Please make it employee friendly, I’ve heard it works good on the scheduling side. But it sure doesn’t work well if you’re the one being scheduled.
